The Balaclava Rapist

By: Sasha Schwendenwein | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Over 100 woman have fallen victim to a man in Alexandra, Carte Blanche investigates his modus operandi and speaks to the victims and police.

Summary:
Since 2005 an unknown man has been prowling the jukskei park in Alexandra. Nothing is known about him, other than he is a 1,7m tall black male and wears a balaclava. Carte Blanche has found cases dating back to 2005 up until January 2015. The man prowls the park usually over the weekends and chooses a couple. He forces them into the graveyard at gun point and then makes the male victim rape the female victim, and then proceeds to rape the female victim himself. Is is progressing and improving on his skills, as last year he recruited a second male to aid him and in January he took 3 couples into the cemetery. Criminal profiler Professor Anni Hesselink has agreed to make a profile of the balaclava rapist. She thinks he is highly dangerous and that a story may help the community, put pressure on the police and possibly help catch him, as the rapist may see the pressure and make mistakes. Hesselink's last profile helped the police catch child rapist Fanwell Khumalo in Hillbrow. Hesselink believes that this man is intelligent, and that what he is acting out was most likely an event of trauma in his past.

Further information:
BALACLAVA SERIAL RAPIST
Hunting Ground: Alexandra Park (Juksei River park – East bank)
SOURCE: Refers to the persons I have spoken to about the case (it is a police officer) and who brought it to my attention. They have asked CARTE BLANCHE for help and would like us to give this story airtime so that we can warn people and put pressure on their superiors to give them resources for help.
THE AREA:
https://www.google.co.za/maps/place/Alexandra,+2090/@-26.1004621,28.106706,865m/data=!3m1!1e3!4m2!3m1!1s0x1e950d539f33d86d:0xba9789de8bd1fbb3?hl=en
AREA: About 3km squared
The cemetery is located on the North of the park. There is a school located to the EAST, and a skate park/theatre and Jungle gyms in the park. The bridge connected the East Bank to the centre of Alex.

MODUS OPERANDI / MO:
Targets- a boy and girl, or young man and woman – always a couple.
Average age of victim 20 according to SOURCE
Attacks occur around 6 - 6.30PM – As it just gets dark. It’s possible he targets youngsters because they meeting in the park away from parents and are inexperienced and easier targets.
A man approx 1.7m tall and thin approaches couple by the bridge/in the park he is wearing long sleeves and a balaclava. He points a gun and threatens them and asks for their cell phones/money/weapons. He makes them follow him usually into the cemetery, where there are no lights and no one can hear you screaming. Once he has them alone he asks them for their cell phones, he takes the sim cards out and gives them back their phones. Then he tells them to take off their clothes. He then makes the MALE victim (usually a boyfriend or friend) rape the woman (often they pretend). This is compelled rape. SOURCE believes this is to mix up the rape kit – ruin evidence. If they refuse they are shot dead (there are murder cases opened against him) then he covers the male victims head with a jacket. He tells him he will kill him if he moves. He then rapes the woman vaginally, usually he makes her lie on her front face down, sometimes he asks them to bend over so that they are in a “doggy style “position. Sometimes he beats the woman on the head and is violent with them, however, if the couple do as they are told he is not violent. The entire incident takes about 20 minutes. He then leaves and tells them he will come back but never does OR he tells them that they may not go to the police, and often he asks them for their physical addresses and says if they do he’ll find them.
PROGRESSION – In 2014 he got a second man to start helping him. He also started stealing the phones and together they started taking more than 1 couple – sometimes 3 (January).
He does not use a condom. They do not know if he has HIV. Some of the victims had HIV before, and the ones who are raped are put onto the antiretroviral’s immediately. They do have his DNA from the rape kits.

10 CHILD CASES of rape
1. 492/2/2013 -- 13/021 – Rape 16
2. 310/12/2013 – 13/341 – Rape 14
3. 246/8/2014 -- -- Rape 16
4. 114/01/2015 – 15/001 – Rape 15
5. 224/01/2015 – 15/004 – Rape 15
6. 246/08/2014 -- -- Rape 17
7. 515/10/2014 – 14/283 – Rape 16
8. 369/10/2014 – 14/275 – Rape 13
9. 943/5/2014 – 14/149 – Rape 14
10. No case opened because she was victimised and blamed for being raped – Rape 15
112 CASES
89 Cases of rape – women up until May last year – SOURCE estimates that it’s probably around 120 or so. He said he is still compiling the list.
WHAT DO WE KNOW ABOUT HIM?
He’s extremely cunning.
SHOOTOUT:
Last year before May there was a shootout between SOURCE and two suspects they believe were him. They interrupted them about to rape a couple. SOURCE was casing the park and noticed two men in the cemetery. He walked over and called out to them, they two men fired at him. He fired back. But there were palisades separating them and the SOURCE was not shot. SOURCE chased suspects over the east embankment of park where there is a “hill” leading to a sports field. The suspects got away. SOURCE suggests he either knows the police station well - may be a police officer/ cleaner at the station or familiar with new police vehicles and who the officers are. He said the police did not retrieve the projectile’s as they were stuck in palisades that separate the park from the cemetery. Most likely a revolver – definitely not a shot gun. SOURCE suggests he may have military training as during the shootout he had no problem firing at the SOURCE. SOURCE is the only one to have seen him 3-4 meters away. SOURCE interrupted both men while they were about to rape a couple – that’s how they know it’s the same man. SOURCE said the second man did not have a gun, but there was a stolen firearm case opened in the park recently and now the second suspect has a gun. Possible it’s the same weapon.
SOURCE says the police came and watched the park after that, but the suspect did not surface. When the police stopped watching, the balaclava rapist came back. Possible he found another hunting ground during this period, but maybe not. The Rapist clearly realized that the Alex station does not have a large enough force to keep constant surveillance on the park. But it’s also possible that he knows other stations may be better equipped and if he changes location that may bring the police stations together.
He wears a balaclava and he has a jacket to cover his arms. They don’t even know how dark his complexion is.
He may be from Zimbabwe, because he told several victims this. However, he could be telling people lies in order to put police on wrong track.
We had another SOURCE tell us that he uses a mining head light during the rapes – 1. The Victims cannot see his face and 2. So he can get away quick. They are small and almost undetectable in the dark cemetery. THE PRIMARY SOURCE could not confirm this.
12 cases confirmed through DNA
Varies month to month how many cases there are – the only time he has ever disappeared was after the shooting.

Press Release:


Balaclava Rapist
He’s been positively linked to over 100 rape cases in 10 years, but is still a free man. How has South Africa’s most prolific serial rapist managed to foil police for so long? Carte Blanche follows the trail of the so-called Balaclava Rapist.


Script:


ALEXANDRA TOWNSHIP... WHERE 200-THOUSAND RESIDENTS LIVE IN A MAIZE OF HOUSES. THE NEARBY JUKSKEI PARK IS AN IDEAL PLACE FOR COUPLE’S LOOKING FOR PRIVACY. THEY STROLL THROUGH THE PARK, ONE OF ALEXANDRA’S FEW GREEN LUNGS. [TRANSITION] YET THEY RISK THIER LIVES DOING SO, AS THEY ARE BEING HUNTED BY A MAN KNOWN AS THE BALACLAVA RAPIST.
IN 2013 SIMPHIWE, NOT HER REAL NAME, WAS 19 AND WRITING HER FINAL MATRIC EXAMS. HAVING LEFT CHURCH WITH HER BOYFRIEND, THEY WERE ENJOYING A LAZY LATE SUNDAY AFTERNOON TOGETHER. THE COUPLE, ABSORBED IN EACH OTHER, HAD LET THEIR GUARD DOWN.
AROUND DUSK AT 6 PM A MAN SUDDENLY CONFRONTED THEM.
SIMPHIWE: By that time there were no people around.
DEVI: What was he wearing?
SIMPHIWE: He was wearing a balaclava.
As he came, he pointed at us with a gun.
NO OTHER TOWNSHIP RESIDENTS SAW THE MAN FORCE THEM TO WALK INTO THE NEARBY GRAVEYARD AT GUN POINT. HE GAVE THE COUPLE A CHOICE.
SIMPHIWE: I’m punishing you now, it’s either you go home naked or you’re having sex here...
HE THREATENED TO KILL THEM IF THEY DID NOT HAVE SEX.
he pointed a gun on us and said, “you’re doing it here while I’m watching you.”
SIMPHIWE AND HER BOYFRIEND WERE FORCED TO UNDRESS WHILE THE ASSAILANT WATCHED INTENTLY. SIMPHIWE’S BOYFRIEND PRETENDED TO RAPE HER.
BUT IT WASN’T OVER. THE MAN MADE THEM DRESS, LIE ON THEIR STOMACHS AND THREW A JACKET OVER HER BOYFRIEND’S FACE.
SIMPHIWE: Then he told me to choose whether he sleeps with me or he shoot at him while I am watching. Then I said… I had no choice….And then that’s when he raped me. He got me when I was a virgin then he told me that he is growing me up… It was painful.
THE BALACLAVA RAPIST HAD STRUCK AGAIN, BUT FOR ALEXANDRA’S RESIDENTS LIFE CONTINUED AS BEFORE.
THE RAPIST’S MODUS OPERANDI, DESCRIPTIONS OF THE PERPETRATOR AND THE LOCATION OF SIMPHIWE’S ATTACK COINCIDE WITH OTHER REPORTED CASES. SINCE 2005 IT’S SUSPECTED THAT OVER 100 REPORTED CASES AT THE ALEXANDRA POLICE STATION MATCH THE SPECIFIC APPROACH USED BY THE SO-CALLED BALACLAVA RAPIST WHO’s SUSPECTED OF RAPING SIMPHIWE.
DEVI: WHILE WE CAN’T REVEAL THE INTRICATE DETIAL OF THE POLICE’S INVESTIGATION SO FAR, WE EXAMINED A QUARTER OF THE 100 CASES AND FOUND THEM CHILLINGLY SIMILAR.
Annie: It’s very very scary to think one man can cause so much hurt and damage in other people’s lives. This is 100 cases that has been reported, there might be many more victims that feel too ashamed to go and report it.
PROFESSOR ANNI HESSELINK A FORENSIC CRIMINOLOGIST CREATED THE PROFILE THAT HELPED CATCH FANWELL KHUMALO, THE SERIAL PAEDOPHILE RAPIST WHO HUNTED YOUNG SCHOOL GIRLS IN HILLBROW IN 2003.
Annie: The whole purpose of a profile is to exclude characteristics, causes of the behaviour, reasons why a person rape[s] or kill[s], rather than to include.
DEVI: FOR THE PAST 10 YEARS THE POLICE HAVE BEEN UNABLE TO APREHEND THE BALACLAVA RAPIST. SO WE ASKED PROFESSOR HESSELINK TO PROFILE THE RAPIST BASED ON WHAT THE VICTIMS REMEMBERED.
THE JUKSKEI PARK IS LOCATED IN THE HEART OF THE ALEXANDRA TOWNSHIP. A CEMETARY LIES ON ITS EAST BANK AND A SCHOOL JUST ABOVE THAT. INCLUDING THE CEMETARY THE PARK COVERS THREE-SQUARE-KILOMETERS. ONLY ONE BRIDGE CONNECTS THE PARK TO THE REST OF ALEX.
Annie: We’re working with a very serious and a very deviant and a very sadistic predator, whose known in the area but not yet identified.
JANE, NOT HER REAL NAME, IS A PASSIONATE DANCER. SHE WAS 17 IN 2013 AND WAS ENJOYING A BREAK FROM DANCE CLASSES DURING THE SCHOOL HOLIDAYS. AFTER SUNSET, AROUND 8PM, SHE WAS WALKING HOME WITH A MALE FRIEND – THROUGH THE JUKSKEI PARK- WHEN A MAN WEARING A BALACLAVA APPROACHED THEM.
Annie: The time frame is most probably linked to his availability – either his leisure time, his work, working shifts, being off at that time.
IT WOULD SEEM THE ATTACKS GENERALLY TAKE PLACE ON WEEKENDS BETWEEN 6 AND 8PM WHEN ALEXANDRA’S RESIDENTS ESCAPE THE BUSY TOWNSHIP FOR QUITER SPOTS.
JANE: He asked if we were dating and we’re like, no, we just friends.
Annie: Targeting couples might be linked to his own childhood trauma, where he might have been involved in childhood sexual exposure – an early onset of inappropriate sexual behaviour or stimulation.
HE POINTED A GUN AT THEM AND MADE THEM WALK TO THE BACK OF THE CEMETARY. HE THEN ORDERED HER FRIEND TO HAVE SEX WITH HER.
“JANE” He shot like twice, or once, I can’t remember.
Devi: in the air?
JANE: Yes. And then he’s like, if you don’t do it, I’m going to kill the both of you.
ANNI SUGGESTES THAT HE’S MOST LIKELY A VERY NORMAL, QUIET MAN.
Annie: then he switches personality, and he becomes the aggressor, the predator.
HIS THREATS ARE NOT EMPTY. IN FEBRUARY LAST YEAR HE REPORTEDLY KILLED A MAN.
By killing the men, he just proves how powerful he is.
ALSO A PROFESSOR OF CRIMINOLOGY AT UNISA, ANNI’S PROFILING DRAWS ON OTHER SIMILAR CASES.
ANNIE: The majority of rapists do not do it for the sexual gratification. It’s about power and control.
AFTER JANE’S FRIEND HAD FORCED SEX WITH HER, THE ASSAILANT COVERED HIS HEAD AND PROCEEDED TO RAPE HER.
Jane: He made sure his hands were on …like my face.
Devi: And then you said that you heard a voice speaking to him?
Jane: Mm, just after he was done. There was...a voice… So it sounded like he was being called upon… And then he whistled back as he was running.
IN 2014, SHORTLY AFTER JANE’S ATTACK, AN ACCOMPLICE BEGAN JOINING IN ON THE RAPES.

Anni: His accomplice knows that he has killed before. So he’s most probably looking up to him, admiring him. But also, he’s scared of him.

IN JANUARY 2015 THE BALACLAVA RAPIST TARGETED THREE COUPLES SIMILTANEOUSLY. HE MADE THE MEN RAPE EACH WOMAN PRESENT. THEN BOTH ASSAILANTS ALSO RAPED THE FEMALE VICTIMS, SO EACH WAS RAPED 5 TIMES. AGAIN ALEXANDRA’S RESIDENTS SAW AND HEARD NOTHING.
Annie: The excitement in just having a couple, instructing them, raping them, having his accomplice raping them, is not enough anymore.”
In my experience, serial rapists and serial killers only stop when they’re caught. Because it’s an addiction.”
BOTH SIMPHIWE AND JANE WENT TO THE ALEXANDRA POLICE STATION TO REPORT THEIR RAPES. THEY WERE SHOCKED BY THE POLICE’S CASUAL RESPONSE.
Jane: The lady told me you’re actually not the first person who comes here and tells us this.
SIMPHIWE SAID THE POLICE TREATED HER STORY AS GOSSIP
What was he wearing?
I’m saying a Balaclava.
Ah! At that Graveyard? Ya!
And they were chatting.
It’s the same person. Shame!
SIMPHIWE: if you can check my… the statement that they took, because of the attitude they gave me… I was not free to OPEN and tell them everything that happened.
Anni: I think he’s telling the police, I’ve outsmarted you for so long now, I’m untouchable, I’m actually above the law.
DEVI: THE VICTIMS WE SPOKE TO SAID THAT THEY HAVE NEVER HEARD BACK FROM THE POLICE, AND STATEMENTS WERE NOT TAKEN FROM THE MALE VICTIMS INVOLVED. THERE ARE TOO MANY QUESTIONS AND IT IS TIME TO GET SOME ANSWERS.
THE POLICE REFUSED TO PARTICIPATE IN THE STORY BY GIVING AN INTERVIEW OR ANSWERS TO WRITTEN QUESTIONS AND INSTEAD THREATENED TO INTERDICT US TO PREVENT THE STORY FROM BEING BROADCAST CLAIMING THAT THE STORY WOULD HARM THEIR INVESTIGATION.

LAST YEAR THE MEC FOR COMMUNITY SAFETY IN GAUTENG, SIZAKELE NKOSI MALOBANE VISITED THE ALEXANDRA POLICE STATION AND SAID THE SPATE OF CRIME IN GENERAL WAS DUE TO A LACK OF VISIBILITY DURING PATROLS AND A LACK OF ASSISTANCE FROM COMPLACENT OFFICERS.
DEVI: ALTHOUGH THERE HAVE BEEN SO MANY REPORTED CASES, ALEXANDRA RESIDENTS BELIEVE THE BALACLAVA RAPIST IS A MYTH.
Elizabeth: It’s not a myth, it’s the truth. It is happening. We even organised a march in 2010 to let people know about these cases happening at Jukskei Park.
Devi: And?
Elizabeth: But still people they don’t – unless if it happens to somebody, the neighbour, or your own child, then they believe it.
ELIZABETH WORKS FOR WOMEN AND MEN AGAINST CHILD ABUSE AT THE ALEXANDRA VICTIMS UNIT. IN 2013 SHE BECAME AWARE THAT THE BALACLAVA RAPIST WAS ALSO TARGETING CHILDREN, SOME AS YOUNG AS 13, USING THE VERY SAME MODUS OPERANDI.
Elizabeth: The police are doing what they could do, because they even went to the park to look for him. Then when they approached at the park he started shooting at the police.
AS THE OFFICERS WERE NOT IN UNIFORM, THIS SUGGESTS THE RAPIST HAS KNOWLEGDE OF LOCAL POLICE. ELIZABETH SAYS RAPE IS DESTROYING THE COMMUNITY. SHE FEELS HOPELESS AND ANGRY WHEN RESIDENTS SAY THAT AT LEAST THE VICTIMS AREN’T MURDERED.
Elizabeth: It’s killing me. You know people who don’t see those victims, they will think it’s normal, You know we as the person who are the first to see those, when we go home sometimes, we don’t even think properly. It’s traumatizing.

THE KIDS’ CLINIC SOCIAL WORKERS HAVE COUNSELLED 10 CHILD VICTIMS. ONE OF THEM IS 14-YEAR OLD SOPHIE, NOT HER REAL NAME. SHE WROTE THIS LETTER TO THE BALACLAVA RAPIST AS PART OF HER THERAPY.
READS LETTER
“I write this letter to you without knowing who you are, I am the girl you raped. What happened in the park was very painful...you can’t go on raping other innocent girls.
In our world we have to love others and to protect one another...So I wish the police will do what’s best to find you.
From Sophie.”
SIMPHIWE: I hate Alex. At the graveyard, there’s a river, Jukskei river, I wanted to throw myself there because I thought it’s over now.
BUT INSTEAD SIMPHIWE FOUND THE STRENGTH TO FINISH MATRIC AND IS NOW AT UNIVERSITY.
JANE SAID HER PASSION FOR DANCE HAS HELPED HER EXPRESS HER PAIN. ALTHOUGH, SHE WONDERS IF THE MAN WHO RAPED HER WILL EVER BE CAUGHT.
Devi: Explain to people who don’t understand what rape does to you.
Jane: You are going to, like, find it very hard to move on. It frustrates me. The fact that he’s still OUT THERE! And we have people who are supposed to catch criminals, and we still not doing anything about this.
